description: One-shot research digest for one security: views (PRIMARY), quote, valuation snapshot, market sentiment, supplementary news, ownership_events (30-day insider trades + buybacks, next-30-day lockups) and margin (~7 trading days). Margin is **T+1** — judge direction by `financing_net_buy_cny`, never gross `financing_buy_cny`. Separate buckets, not ranked against each other; partial failures go to `meta.partial_failures[]`. First call for 'what's going on with <stock>'. A-share returns all buckets; HK/US return only views + news. A+H: pass the A-share canonical.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

code.description: Canonical code: A-share SSE:600519 | HK HK:00700 | US US:BABA. HK/US return only views+news. Use `lookup` first if you only have a name.

limit_per_bucket.description: Per-bucket item cap (views/news). Quote/snapshot/sentiment aren't paginated here.

news_hours.description: Lookback for news bucket (hours, default 24 — event horizon)

views_since_days.description: Lookback for views bucket (days, 1-30; views feed caps at 30d). For longer research history use the `views` verb's from/to.

name: digest
